data.title: Cart sessions show inconsistent state after cache schema migration
data.customer_impact: Checkout completion rate is below the 99% service objective; customer-facing errors are active.
data.operator_note: Alert correlation tentatively points to checkout-service.
data.objective: Restore checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and critical services to healthy state.

payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The cache schema migration introduced a mismatch between the Redis key format used by the checkout-service and the new schema, causing session data to be partially overwritten or lost, leading to inconsistent cart state and checkout failures.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify that the Redis cache contains the expected key format and data for a sample cart session after the migration.', success_signal='Key pattern matches the new schema and session data is complete (no missing fields).', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Check the checkout-service logs for cache miss or deserialization errors during checkout attempts.', success_signal='No cache-related errors; all sessions load successfully from Redis.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Rollback the cache schema migration in a staging environment and run a checkout flow to confirm cart state consistency.', success_signal='Checkout completes successfully with 99% success rate and p95 latency <=800ms.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='If rollback fixes the issue, identify the specific key/serialization change that caused the mismatch.', success_signal='Differential analysis shows a key prefix or field name change that is not handled by the service.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Patch the checkout-service to support both old and new key formats during a transitional period.', success_signal='Service loads sessions from either format without errors and maintains 99% success rate.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='Deploy the patch to production and monitor checkout success and latency metrics.', success_signal='Checkout success >=99%, p95 <=800ms, and no customer-facing errors for 30 minutes.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='Verify recovery by running a synthetic checkout flow and performing a cache consistency audit.', success_signal='Synthetic checkout passes and audit shows all active sessions use the new schema.', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Document the root cause, remediation steps, and update the migration playbook to include backward compatibility checks.', success_signal='Documentation approved by SRE and DevOps teams and added to runbooks.', status='pending')], revision=0, rationale_summary='The alert correlation points to checkout-service, and the incident title references a cache schema migration. Inconsistent cart state after a schema change is a common symptom of key format or serialization mismatches. Redis is the suspected service, so the root cause likely lies in the migration script or the service’s cache access logic.')
